title: Critique: the anti-emergence argument does not exclude panprotopsychism

statements.text: Strawson may not rule out panprotopsychism: there may be non-experiential properties, not yet conceived or beyond human grasp, from which experience emerges intelligibly. If hidden properties do the work, the experiential character of the ultimates adds nothing.

sources.quote: It is not clear that Strawson is able to conclusively rule out the panprotopsychist option discussed above.
then I think she ought just to be a panprotopsychist
